title: potentilla norvegica var. labradorica
intro: Potentilla norvegica var. labradorica, commonly known as Creeping Cinquefoil, is a low-growing, spreading perennial plant native to the Arctic tundra. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its purported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, improve wound healing, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in Creeping Cinquefoil, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are believed to exert therapeutic actions like antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory effects. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Creeping Cinquefoil as a medicinal plant.
